question: Do pure Fabric mods that run on a native Fabric server fail on Forbric? Same jars, same world settings, server side.

forbricOnly.subject: notenoughcrashes-fabric-4.4.9+26.2.jar
forbricOnly.cause: The kernel reports a mixin whose target method does not exist in vanilla 26.2 either as a confirmed required loss, and the strict/headless policy refuses the launch.
evidence: MixinTileEntity @Inject method=populateCrashReport; vanilla 26.2 BlockEntity has fillCrashReportCategory and no populateCrashReport, so on native Fabric the injector matches nothing and is skipped silently (no defaultRequire in notenoughcrashes.mixins.json)
Forbric log: auto-suppressing guest mixin notenoughcrashes:MixinTileEntity, UNFIT (no anchor resolves (@Inject target BlockEntity.populateCrashReport))
compatibility-report finding mixin:notenoughcrashes.mixins.json:fudge.notenoughcrashes.mixins.MixinTileEntity CONFIRMED required=true
forbricOnly.defectClass: compatibility policy false positive: a mixin anchor missing from vanilla too is counted as a Forbric loss
forbricOnly.where: forbric-kernel KernelGuestMixinAdapter: UNFIT -> report(CONFIRMED, required=config.required) without checking the vanilla class

forbricOnly.subject: debugify-26.2.0.1.jar
forbricOnly.forbricUnderPolicyContinue: DONE, 200 ticks, with the injector left out
forbricOnly.cause: The merged base re-types RangedBowAttackGoal.mob from Monster to Mob, so the call debugify injects after no longer exists.
evidence: RangedBowAttackGoalMixin @Inject tick @At(INVOKE Monster.lookAt(Entity,FF)V)
vanilla 26.2 RangedBowAttackGoal.tick: getfield mob:Monster, invokevirtual Monster.lookAt; merged base: getfield mob:Mob, both calls invokevirtual Mob.lookAt
finding mixin-injector:debugify.mixins.json:...RangedBowAttackGoalMixin#lookAtTarget CONFIRMED required: A required injector has no attachment in the actual defined class
forbricOnly.defectClass: merged base differs from vanilla bytecode (field re-typed, call owner changed)

forbricOnly.subject: EnhancedVisuals_FABRIC_v1.8.30_mc26.2.jar
forbricOnly.forbricUnderPolicyContinue: DONE, 200 ticks, with the redirect left out
forbricOnly.cause: The merged base's ServerConfigurationPacketListenerImpl.handleConfigurationFinished is NeoForge's body, which calls a different RegistryFriendlyByteBuf.decorator overload than the one CreativeCore redirects.
evidence: CreativeCore ServerConfigurationPacketListenerImplMixin @Redirect handleConfigurationFinished @At(INVOKE RegistryFriendlyByteBuf.decorator(RegistryAccess))
vanilla 26.2: invokestatic RegistryFriendlyByteBuf.decorator(RegistryAccess); merged base: decorator(RegistryAccess, neoforge ConnectionType)
fabric-networking-api-v1 misses the same anchor on Forbric (logged as partial, not required)
forbricOnly.defectClass: merged base differs from vanilla bytecode (NeoForge method body)

forbricOnly.subject: ViaVersion-5.12.1-SNAPSHOT.jar
forbricOnly.forbricUnderPolicyContinue: DONE, 200 ticks, but with the 26.1 build's entrypoint the one that ran
forbricOnly.cause: Forbric loads ViaFabric's nested viafabric-mc26-1, whose minecraft dependency (>=26.1 <=26.1.2) excludes 26.2; native Fabric Loader leaves it out. Both nested builds run ViaFabric.onInitialize and the second fails.
evidence: ViaFabric 0.4.22 nests viafabric-mc26-2 (minecraft 26.2|26.3) and viafabric-mc26-1 (minecraft >=26.1 <=26.1.2)
native mod list: viafabric -> viafabric-mc26-2 only
Forbric: invoked main entrypoint of viafabric-mc26-1, then main entrypoint of viafabric-mc26-2 failed: IllegalArgumentException: ViaManager is already set
forbricOnly.defectClass: nested-jar selection ignores an unsatisfied minecraft version dependency

forbricOnly.subject: moreladders-fabric-26.2-3.0.0.jar
forbricOnly.forbricUnderPolicyContinue: DONE, 200 ticks, with moreladders' main entrypoint failed
forbricOnly.cause: The merged base's WeatheringCopper.getNext asks NeoForge's DataMapHooks, which reads the block's registry holder; Fabric API's OxidizableBlocksRegistry calls it during the mod's own init, before the block is bound.
evidence: moreladders onInitialize -> OxidizableBlocksRegistry.registerNextStage -> refreshRandomTickCache -> OxidizableLadder.isRandomlyTicking -> WeatheringCopper.getNext
vanilla 26.2 getNext: NEXT_BY_BLOCK BiMap lookup; merged base: invokestatic neoforge DataMapHooks.getNextOxidizedStage
IllegalStateException: Trying to access unbound value 'Block{[unregistered]}' from registry minecraft:block
forbricOnly.defectClass: merged base differs from vanilla bytecode (NeoForge data-map hook reads an unbound holder)

forbricOnly.subject: MoogsEndStructures-universal-1.21-2.1.1.jar
forbricOnly.forbric: CRASH (kernel stops the server right after Done)
forbricOnly.forbricUnderPolicyContinue: DONE, 200 ticks, with the mixin left out
forbricOnly.cause: The merged base's StructureTemplate.placeEntities has NeoForge's descriptor, so Moog's Structure Lib's EntityProcessorMixin fails to apply and the kernel stops the server on the failed required feature.
evidence: vanilla 26.2: placeEntities(ServerLevelAccessor, BlockPos, Mirror, Rotation, BlockPos, BoundingBox, boolean, ProblemReporter)
merged base: placeEntities(ServerLevelAccessor, BlockPos, Mirror, Rotation, BoundingBox, boolean, ProblemReporter, StructurePlaceSettings)
InvalidInjectionException: Invalid descriptor on moogs_structures-fabric.mixins.json:structures.EntityProcessorMixin
Forbric log after Done: [Forbric/Compatibility] FATAL: a required feature failed during world loading; stopping the server normally
forbricOnly.defectClass: merged base differs from vanilla bytecode (method descriptor)

forbricOnly.subject: meowantixray-fabric-1.6.0.jar
forbricOnly.forbric: CRASH (Encountered an unexpected exception, crash report)
forbricOnly.forbricUnderPolicyContinue: not run: the crash is not a policy decision
forbricOnly.cause: On Forbric BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK is MinecraftForge's NamespacedWrapper, a package-private class; the mod's reflective call on the registry's runtime class throws IllegalAccessException.
evidence: IllegalStateException: Failed to resolve block id minecraft:diamond_ore at MeowAntiXrayMod.onServerStarted
Caused by: IllegalAccessException: class com.meowantixray.compat.MinecraftCompat cannot access a member of class net.minecraftforge.registries.NamespacedWrapper with modifiers "public"
javap: class net.minecraftforge.registries.NamespacedWrapper<T> extends MappedRegistry<T> (no public modifier)
forbricOnly.defectClass: a carrier's registry class replaces vanilla's runtime type

bothFail.subject: beilin-data-portability-fabric-1.21.x-1.2.7.jar
bothFail.cause: built for 1.21.x: NoClassDefFoundError net/minecraft/class_2561 (intermediary name) on both arms; its dependency beilin-entry-control also requires an apiKey config

bothFail.subject: gmm-fabric-26.2-1.0.0.jar
bothFail.cause: NullPointerException: Item id not set in GmmFabric.registerContent on both arms

bothFail.subject: creepertweaks-1.1.0+26.2.jar
bothFail.cause: uses Fabric API without declaring it (neither Modrinth nor fabric.mod.json): NoClassDefFoundError CommandRegistrationCallback on both arms

bothFail.subject: andonium-2.2.1+26.2-fabric.jar
bothFail.cause: native: IllegalStateException This registry can't create intrusive holders during item registration; Forbric: NoClassDefFoundError FabricCreativeModeTab (Fabric API is used but not declared). Different first error, both refuse to start

observations.what: PuzzlesLib logs WARN 'Failed to generate mod list' (NullPointerException: childModContainer is null) on Forbric only
observations.seen: 3 Forbric pack sessions (pack, pack-native-pass, pack-matched-pass), 0 native sessions; not in any per-mod session
observations.effect: caught by the mod; pack-matched-pass still DONE; not counted as a failure

all.native: FAILED_TO_START: first failing main entrypoint stage (beilin-data-portability; beilin-entry-control and gmm suppressed in the same stage)
all.forbric: FAILED_TO_START: policy stop on 7 confirmed findings (beilin x2, gmm, creativecore, debugify, moreladders, viafabric-mc26-2)

nativePass.ddmin: 22 launches; minimal = EnhancedVisuals, debugify, moreladders, ViaVersion (closed: + CreativeCore, ViaFabric, Fabric API); the minimal set is DONE on native, so FORBRIC_ONLY; the four are four of the seven single-mod Forbric-only failures, none is an interaction
